audit_items.proof_trace: A PostgreSQL partial unique index (`announcements_is_current_true_idx ON public.announcements (is_current) WHERE is_current = true`) enforces the cardinality invariant at the DB layer unconditionally — any INSERT/UPDATE that would produce a second `is_current = true` row is rejected by the engine. No application-level TypeScript code touches `announcements` or `is_current`, so there is no bypass path. The `deleted_at IS NULL` condition in the property assertion references a non-existent column (schema uses `is_active` instead), but this does not weaken the actual DB-level guarantee.
